title: Zscaler and Aruba EdgeConnect (Silver Peak) Deployment Guide

blocks.text: The Zscaler and Aruba EdgeConnect (Silver Peak) Deployment Guide provides instructions on how to configure Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) to work with Aruba (Silver Peak) SD-WAN.

The Aruba EdgeConnect unified SD-WAN platform enables customers to build a unified WAN edge that is business-driven, delivers the highest quality of experience, continuously adapts to changing business needs and network conditions.
